name: A Lesson in Divinity
label: Quest
description: A Lesson in Divinity: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A key tenent of being an adventurer is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as adventurers in life.
Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You... You are an adventurer? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
